about: Saved Claude results from the Prompt lab (instructions v-3500), shown on the demo site. Each `reply` has the same shape as the AI's reply, so live AI can replace this file later. Source runs are in prompt-lab-log.json.

inputs.what: The card payment for a subscription failed at checkout
inputs.next: Try again or use another card

options.why: Pick this for most screens where you want to state the problem and next step plainly.

parts.label: Body
parts.text: Your card payment failed at checkout. Try again or use another card.

options.why: Pick this when the reader may worry about their payment or card.

parts.label: Body
parts.text: The card payment didn't go through at checkout. You can try again or choose a different card.

options.why: Pick this for small mobile screens, banners or toasts where space is tight.

parts.label: Body
parts.text: Try again, or use another card.

left_out: The reason the card payment failed (for example declined, expired or network issue), since it wasn't provided.
Whether the reader was charged or whether their cart or details were saved, since no facts were given.
Any support contact or help link, since none was provided.

inputs.what: There's no available dog walkers and sitters

options.why: Pick this for most screens, where busy owners need the facts and next step fast.

parts.label: Body
parts.text: No dog walkers or sitters are free right now. Try the next available time.

options.why: Pick this when owners may feel stressed about a last-minute booking.

parts.label: Body
parts.text: No walkers or sitters are available for this time. Let's find your next best slot.

options.why: Pick this for lighter moments where the brand's playful side can shine.

parts.label: Body
parts.text: Every walker and sitter is booked right now. Pick the next open time.

left_out: Did not mention how far ahead the next available time is, since no timeline was given.
Did not mention notifications, waitlists or other ways to get a walker, since none were listed.
Did not mention a cause (such as location or date), since only 'no available walkers and sitters' was given.
